To bridge this to real users, Cysic built DogeBox 1, a compact ASIC miner that makes ZK computing portable, merging the worlds of high-performance cryptography and consumer accessibility.  Their latest report breaks down not just the tech but the entire playbook from ecosystem strategy to token design to how they plan to outperform traditional clouds.  Because in the next era of the internet, uptime won’t depend on AWS.  It’ll depend on us, the network.

text: Massive Internet Outage Disrupts Snapchat, HMRC, UK Banks and More  AWS at the Center  A widespread internet outage has taken down some of the most-used apps and websites around the world, including Snapchat, Roblox, Fortnite, Duolingo, Canva, and major UK services such as HMRC and online banking for Lloyds, Halifax, and Bank of Scotland.  The disruption began early Monday morning, around 8 a.m. in the UK (midnight Pacific), and was quickly reflected by huge spikes in user complaints on DownDetector. The issue appears to be linked to Amazon Web Services (AWS), which provides the infrastructure that powers much of the modern internet. AWS confirmed it is experiencing increased error rates and delays across multiple services. In a technical update, the company said it has identified a potential root cause related to DNS resolution issues for its DynamoDB database service in the US-EAST-1 region.  As AWS continues its investigation, many of the affected services remain down or unstable. The outage has now stretched over two hours, leaving millions of users without access to essential platforms, online tools, and banking services. #Europost
